title: TAPCO-G: LLM-Guided Design-Adaptive Timing and Power Co-Optimization with Graph-Based Physical Priors
abstract: arXiv:2611.13931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-placement timing and power co-optimization is critical to meeting setup timing targets and reducing power within placement constraints. A cell replacement can improve timing along one path while increasing power or reducing slack on others. Conventional optimizers follow fixed rules for scheduling and accepting repairs, limiting their ability to address design-specific bottlenecks. A large language model (LLM) can propose changes to these rules, but on its own it cannot reliably estimate how a cell replacement affects endpoint slack and power. TAPCO-G combines LLM-guided optimizer adaptation with graph-based physical priors to evaluate candidate cell replacements. The outer loop tunes tool settings using physical-design feedback and revises executable repair policies when tuning stalls. The inner loop anchors delay estimates to static timing analysis snapshots, accounts for upstream driver-load changes, and propagates delay shifts

translated_title: TAPCO-G：基于图物理先验的LLM引导设计自适应时序与功耗协同优化
translated_abstract: 布局后的时序与功耗协同优化对于满足建立时间目标以及在布局约束内降低功耗至关重要。一次单元替换可能改善某条路径的时序，但同时会增加功耗或减少其他路径的时序裕量。传统优化器遵循固定的规则来调度和接受修复操作，这限制了其应对设计特定瓶颈的能力。大型语言模型（LLM）可以提出对这些规则的修改建议，但仅凭其自身无法可靠地估计单元替换对端点时序裕量和功耗的影响。TAPCO-G 将LLM引导的优化器自适应与基于图的物理先验相结合，以评估候选的单元替换方案。外层循环利用物理设计反馈来调整工具设置，并在调优停滞时修订可执行的修复策略；内层循环将延迟估计锚定于静态时序分析快照，考虑上游驱动器负载的变化，并传播延迟偏移。
tldr: TAPCO-G 提出了一个将大语言模型引导的优化器自适应与基于图的物理先验相结合的布局后时序与功耗协同优化框架，通过外层循环调整工具设置并修订修复策略、内层循环基于静态时序分析快照进行可靠的延迟与功耗估计，从而有效解决设计特定的时序与功耗瓶颈。
en_tdlr: TAPCO-G combines LLM-guided optimizer adaptation with graph-based physical priors for design-adaptive post-placement timing and power co-optimization, where an outer loop tunes tool settings and revises repair policies while an inner loop anchors delay and power estimates to static timing analysis snapshots for reliable evaluation.
